searchText: Was there any specific reason for the execution payload to not be introduced in Bellatrix's `LightClientHeader`? <etan_status> Bellatrix data is already collected and being served in the wild, so it is difficult to change that. With Capella/Shanghai (tomorrow), you’ll very soon have the execution paylod data available on all major networks
